column1: # The plugin catalog — every plugin an installer or `hxp install` can offer.
# TAB-separated:  name  kind  source  default  description
#   kind    builtin  ships in this repo under plugins/<name>/
#           zsh      a real zsh plugin, sourced through hellish's zsh dialect
#   source  "-" for builtin, else the URL of the single file to fetch
# Adding a plugin = adding a line here. Nothing else changes: hellish's
# install.sh and `hxp install` both read this file.
# Descriptions are embedded in DOUBLE QUOTES by the wrapper generator: keep
# them free of backticks, $ and backslashes, or they execute at load time.
